description: This file defines the class 'Image_Graph_Dataset' used for representing and manipulating a dataset for chart plotting within the Image_Graph package, including methods for adding points, retrieving dataset statistics, and internal data management.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Dataset
classes.description: Class representing a dataset for chart plotting, with methods for data point management and statistical analysis.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the dataset used for labeling in charts.

methods.name: addPoint
methods.description: Adds a data point to the dataset, updating min/max values accordingly.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the number of data points in the dataset.

methods.name: minimumX
methods.description: Returns the minimum X value in the dataset.

methods.name: maximumX
methods.description: Returns the maximum X value in the dataset.

methods.name: minimumY
methods.description: Returns the minimum Y value in the dataset.

methods.name: maximumY
methods.description: Returns the maximum Y value in the dataset.

methods.name: first
methods.description: Returns the first data point (min X and Y).

methods.name: last
methods.description: Returns the last data point (max X and Y).

methods.name: _setMinimumX
methods.description: Private method to set the minimum X value.

methods.name: _setMaximumX
methods.description: Private method to set the maximum X value.

methods.name: _setMinimumY
methods.description: Private method to set the minimum Y value.

methods.name: _setMaximumY
methods.description: Private method to set the maximum Y value.

methods.name: _reset
methods.description: Resets internal pointer to start of dataset.

methods.name: _nearby
methods.description: Retrieves a point near the internal pointer, with optional step offset.

methods.name: _next
methods.description: Advances internal pointer and returns the next data point.

methods.name: _averageY
methods.description: Calculates the average Y value across the dataset.

methods.name: _median
methods.description: Calculates median of a data array, optionally for a specific quartile.

methods.name: _medianY
methods.description: Calculates median Y value across the dataset.
